title: Mechanism of Hedyotis diffusa-Scutellaria barbata D. Don for treatment of primary liver cancer: analysis with network pharmacology, molecular docking and in vitro validation.
authors: Xu, Meng; Chen, Lina; Wu, Jinyu; Liu, Lili; Shi, Mei; Zhou, Hao; Zhang, Guoliang
journal: Nan fang yi ke da xue xue bao = Journal of Southern Medical University
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究中药成分与肝癌核心基因TP53/ESR1的结合，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate the active ingredients in Hedyotis diffusa-Scutellaria barbata D. Don and the main biological processes and signaling pathways mediating their inhibitory effect on primary hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). METHODS: The core intersecting genes of HCC and the two drugs were screened from TCMSP, Uniport, Genecards, and String databases using Cytoscape software, and GO and KEGG enrichment analyses of the intersecting genes were conducted. Molecular docking between the active ingredients of the drugs and the core genes was carried out using Pubcham, RCSB and Autoduckto to identify the active ingredients with the highest binding energy, whose inhibitory effect on HepG2 cells was verifies using CCK-8 assay, flow cytometry and Western blotting. RESULTS: TP53 and ESR1 were identified as the core genes of HCC and the two drugs. GO and KEGG analyses showed that the two genes were mainly involved in regulation of apoptotic signaling pathway, cell population proliferation, methane raft, and protein kinase activity, and participated in the signaling pathways of apoptosis, proteoglycans in cancer, PI3K Akt signaling pathway, and hepatitis B. Molecular docking studies showed that the active ingredients of the drugs could be docked with TP53 and ESR1 genes under natural conditions, and ursolic acid had the highest binding energy to ESR1 (-4.98 kcal/mol). The results of CCK-8 assay, flow cytometry and Western blotting all demonstrated significant inhibitory effect of ursolic acid on HepG2 cells. CONCLUSIONS: The inhibitory effect of Hedyotis diffusa-scutellariae barbatae on HCC is mediated by multiple active ingredients in the two drugs.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨白花蛇舌草-半枝莲（Hedyotis diffusa-Scutellaria barbata D. Don）中的活性成分及其介导抑制原发性肝细胞癌（HCC）的主要生物学过程和信号通路。方法：利用Cytoscape软件从TCMSP、Uniport、Genecards和String数据库中筛选HCC与两药的核心交集基因，并对交集基因进行GO和KEGG富集分析。通过Pubcham、RCSB和Autoduckto对药物活性成分与核心基因进行分子对接，以鉴定结合能最高的活性成分，并使用CCK-8实验、流式细胞术和Western blotting验证其对HepG2细胞的抑制作用。结果：TP53和ESR1被确定为HCC与两药的核心基因。GO和KEGG分析显示，这两个基因主要参与凋亡信号通路调控、细胞群体增殖、甲烷筏和蛋白激酶活性，并参与凋亡、癌症中的蛋白聚糖、PI3K-Akt信号通路和乙型肝炎等信号通路。分子对接研究表明，药物活性成分在自然条件下可与TP53和ESR1基因对接，其中熊果酸与ESR1的结合能最高（-4.98 kcal/mol）。CCK-8实验、流式细胞术和Western blotting结果均显示熊果酸对HepG2细胞具有显著抑制作用。结论：白花蛇舌草-半枝莲对HCC的抑制作用由两药中的多种活性成分介导。
